00037 JuceMIDIInputListener::JuceMIDIInputListener(const bool activate) throw()
00038 {
00039     if(activate)
00040     {
00041         JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster *broadcaster = JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::getInstance();
00042         broadcaster->addListener(dynamic_cast<JuceMIDIInputListener*> (this));
00043     }
00044 }
00045 
00046 JuceMIDIInputListener::~JuceMIDIInputListener() //throw()
00047 {
00048     JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::getInstance()->removeListener(dynamic_cast<JuceMIDIInputListener*> (this));
00049 }
00050 
00051 JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster() throw()
00052 {
00053     const int numDevices = MidiInput::getDevices().size();
00054     for(int i = 0; i < numDevices; i++)
00055     {
00056         MidiInput* midiInput = MidiInput::openDevice(i, this);
00057         midiInput->start();
00058         midiInputs.add(midiInput);
00059     }
00060 }
00061 
00062 JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::~JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster() throw()
00063 {
00064     for(int i = 0; i < midiInputs.size(); i++)
00065     {
00066         MidiInput* midiInput = midiInputs.getUnchecked(i);
00067         midiInput->stop();
00068         delete midiInput;
00069     }
00070 }
00071 
00072 juce_ImplementSingleton (JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster);
00073 
00074 void JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::handleIncomingMidiMessage (MidiInput* source, const MidiMessage& message) throw()
00075 {
00076     sendIncomingMidiMessage(source, message);
00077 }
00078 
00079 void JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::addListener (JuceMIDIInputListener* const newListener) throw()
00080 {       
00081     if (newListener != 0)
00082         midiInputListeners.add (newListener);
00083 }
00084 
00085 void JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::removeListener (JuceMIDIInputListener* const listener) throw()
00086 {       
00087     if(midiInputListeners.contains(listener))
00088         midiInputListeners.removeValue(listener);
00089 }
00090 
00091 void JuceMIDIInputBroadcaster::sendIncomingMidiMessage(MidiInput* source, const MidiMessage& message) throw()
00092 {
00093     for (int i = midiInputListeners.size(); --i >= 0;)
00094     {
00095         JuceMIDIInputListener* const ml = (JuceMIDIInputListener*) midiInputListeners[i];
00096         
00097         if (ml != 0)
00098         {
00099             ml->handleIncomingMidiMessage(source, message);
00100         }
00101     }
00102 }
